scope: Serving settings only; no model or LSA map training. Native stock attention; no LSA source modifications or LSA environment.

common.derive_args_from: authoritative current production config, hash pinned at start
common.control_engine: Installed official production-qualified0.1.50 cfg.exe (ae49... according to parent), with cfg.lib_dirs. Do not substitute retained capture build.
common.candidate_engine: Official stock0.1.56 CUDA13 engine manifest build06698c674673+cuda13.0, SHA21cb8dd0c744c84176a019ef3cfebd27997968f211b197429df897cc6af92788; only its matched supplied .so libraries.
fixed_model: same native IQ3_S assets and hashes
same control-vector bytes, scale, project mode, per-layer direction and layer range4..44
common.fixed_mtp: Preserve production MTP/spec6/suffix3 and measured min-p. Validate resolved INFO fields against source, not one hardcoded spec value; batch excludes automatic lookup-max-t12. Do not enable batch-MTP.
common.environment: Start from scrubbed inherited STRATA_/CUDA_/NVIDIA_/LD_ environment, then explicitly restore approved production env and matched candidate library paths. Remove all STRATA_LSA_ variables. Keep pinned production SELF_COMMIT/QSA_SLOTS/SLOT_COPY_DIRECT/SLOT_COPY_BATCHSYNC and PF_FUSED0 for version-only arm.

budgets.max_profile_starts: Bound each screening profile to one engine start; at most five candidates including same-settings, plus six interleaved confirmation arms. Runtime budget2700s is authoritative.
budgets.tuning_rules: Required order: version-only same-settings first, exact9 stack second, wrapper GDN defaults third. Only then screen PF_FUSED1, and only evaluate2048/share0.5 scheduling arm if baseline mixed latency warrants. At most two optional tuning arms; no combinations beyond listed closures, no arbitrary sweeps.

stages.name: preflight
actions: Verify exact owned HOLD via maintenance helper, inactive production, no GPU compute apps, no current other model. Repeat HOLD/config hash checks every3s.
No live downloads/builds; compile MAX_JOBS<=8 only while model stopped and before timing. One owned model process group at a time.

Verify hardware/driver/GPU UUID, CPU/RAM/cgroup capacity, 80,000MiB free VRAM before launch, MemAvailable>=8GiB and SwapFree>=2GiB; stop if MemAvailable<4GiB or sustained swap-out. Record actual free/peak values.

Record GPU power/temp/clocks/util/memory every1s; reject thermal or power throttling that differs between arms. Desktop graphics load is recorded; require compute-app list empty prelaunch. Sunshine stays stopped.
Capture production config/contract SHA, model/tokenizer/cvec/MTP hashes, executable and all matched .so hashes, env/args and source provenance. Production files stay unchanged.

stages.name: version_comparison
measure: cold4K and16K prefill2reps per arm with unique synthetic prefixes
solo4K generation256max2reps; record tokens/time, MTP acceptance and lookup counters
C8 eight-live-slot256max2reps; require every slot>=128 actual tokens, report admission-inclusive wall plus steady decode aggregate
one mixed-load run:4 established decoders then cold32K joiner, record joinerTTFT and established streams longest token gap
stages.purpose: Required first benchmark: exact same approved settings and capacity on official0150 vs native stock0156. Then separately measure full fresh-wrapper-recommended defaults so no wrapper-only optimization is missed.

stages.name: bounded_screen
measure: parallel9: exact-task tuning6 + cold4K/16K, solo256 and eight-live-slot256 performance; same current four flags plus five new ones. Upstream bit-exact claim still locally gated.
recommended_gdn: same9 plus TC1/CONVL22, fresh quality gate and4K/16K prefill; after qualifying9 baseline.
fused_prefill: optional only after wrapper-defaults benchmark; same9+GDN+PF_FUSED1, rounding change requires task quality.
latency_chunks_if_needed: optional only after measured mixed-load gap/TTFT issue; same9+GDN with prefill2048/share0.5; if GDN does not qualify, regenerate frozen profile on9-only and record newSHA.
stages.retain: All capacity/residency pass, no infrastructure errors, no new quality failure among control-correct fixtures; existing model failures remain explicit. >=3% target median improvement without>5%other regression; two repeats are screening only.

stages.name: confirmation
stages.order: A,B / B,A / A,B; new owned engine process per arm; same fixtures and parity of warmup/cache state
measure: all6 interleaved arms use frozen cold4K/16K, solo256, C8>=128tokens/slot, mixed-load32K metrics
three paired ratios reported individually plus median; use actual tokens and raw wall seconds
Fresh heldout exact fixtures only after profile frozen; baseline and finalist once each
Finalist and baseline each one near125K prompt with three seed-derived markers at12%,55%,89%, max_new64 and actual token count+allowance<=131072
One native8slot cancel+resume/prefix lifecycle test and final loopback API JSON/tool/cancel/image regression smoke with unchanged installed wrapper and correct candidate library bundle
stages.winner: All capacity/API gates pass and no new heldout failure on control-correct cases; preserve shared failures explicitly. No>5%median performance regression across mandatory workloads; speedup claim only target median paired gain>=5%and all3pair signs agree. Otherwise retain baseline/report neutral or tradeoff. No automatic production promotion.

harness_changes_needed: Reuse existing external Guard/process-group cleanup, but point control at official installed0.1.50; retained capture0.1.50 is a separate diagnostic control only.
Use new source/tokenizer adapter rather than oldSOURCE constant; no candidate LSA-map hash/startup-marker checks. Explicitly assert no LSA env or enabled startup marker.

Native DONE.parse must tolerate source-compatible appended fields and validate finite timings/counters. Pin resolved batch/group/window/MTP fields per profile; do not require exact cross-version output IDs for rounding-changing paths.

Old eight-slot cancel-after3tokens case proves lifecycle only; never call it throughput. New C8 performance must keep8 slots live long enough, record8BADM before steady sample and per-slot token timestamps.
Record cold versus prefix-reused requests separately. Fresh repeat prefixes prevent warm prefix cache from impersonating cold prefill; accepted-prefix reuse tested as another workload.
Final quality fixtures heldout from screening; no consumed LSA captures or pilot test set used. No changing fixture oracle after seeing a failure.

Read profiles.json with schema_version1/control/profiles list. All candidate env/arg overrides are fully explicit. Because recommended profiles inherit base cfg and set overrides, source child_env setdefault behavior is emulated without replacing native binary or wrapper during tuning.

source_backed_defaults.native_vs_wrapper: Direct native launch does not invoke Python child_env. Its low-level GDN flags are opt-in, while LinuxCUDA0.1.56 wrapper sets defaults using setdefault. Explicit cfg/shell values win.

gdn.applicability: LinuxCUDA qwen4exp, independent of slot count. Qualified upstream rounding change, not bitwise.
gdn.qualification_note: CONVL2=2 is distinct from the old AMD table CONVL2=1. Do not treat AMD-only arch-default caution as excluding the newer CUDA wrapper setting.

native_memory_defaults.note: PF_W16_CACHE and AUTO_NOBORROW are native free-VRAM-gated defaults, not wrapper env. Leave native decisions unchanged and record resolved allocation. Explicit --prefill prevents AUTO_NOBORROW new-auto-chunk rule.

quality_assessment.tuning_gate: No new failure on any case the retained control answers correctly. Preserve all raw failed baseline and candidate observations. Do not rewrite fixture questions/expected values or call shared failures correct.
quality_assessment.heldout_gate: Fresh heldout critical retrieval/API/capacity gates remain strict where retained control passes; any new candidate failure rejects qualification. Shared control/candidate failures remain explicitly failed and limit claims.
quality_assessment.reason: Initial retained-control run fails independently verified arithmetic644 and53. Zero-error tuning gate cannot be satisfied by baseline and would confound model ability with engine regressions.
quality_assessment.model_training: This campaign tunes serving settings only; no weight training or optimizer state.
